verifications.claim: As of mid-March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates are holding steady around 6.1% to 6.2%
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Freddie Mac... 30-year fixed-rate mortgage (FRM) averaged 6%... On March 10, the 30-year FRM was 6.09% (R9); The benchmark 30-year fixed rate mortgage rate ticked up to 6.11% from 6% last week (R11)
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for rates around 6.1% in early/mid-March 2026 from Freddie Mac surveys; slight tick up indicates holding steady.

verifications.claim: As of mid-March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates are hovering near their lowest levels since 2022
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mortgage rates held steady at 6% this week, hovering near their lowest level since 2022," said Sam Khater, Freddie Mac’s chief economist (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Exact phrasing and context from Freddie Mac report cited in mid-March timeframe.

verifications.claim: 30-year fixed mortgage rates holding steady around 6.1% to 6.2% as of mid-March 2026 has increased refinancing and buyer activity
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: rates... spurring activity from buyers, sellers and owners. As a result, refinance activity is up (R9); hovering around 6% this year, an encouraging backdrop for prospective home shoppers (R11)
verifications.reasoning: Rate levels supported, activity increase mentioned but attributed broadly to lower rates vs. 2024 rather than specifically 'holding steady at 6.1-6.2%'; less precise causal link.
